label: extension

args.body:
Hello,

I am writing to enquire about a group stay at City Hub Tokyo. We are a group of 10 people looking to book accommodation for June.

Could you please let me know:
1. Whether you have availability for a group of 10 in June, and which dates would be possible?
2. What room types/configurations you can offer for a group of this size?
3. Your group booking rates and any special terms or discounts for group reservations?

I would appreciate any additional information about the group booking process, including deposit or payment requirements.

Thank you very much for your time. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Email: emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
Phone: 327-420-4923
args.subject: Group Booking Enquiry - Availability for 10 People in June
